Reconsidérer.

examples.text: Er setzte sich hin und überdachte seine Entscheidung.
examples.translation: Il s’est assis et a reconsidéré à sa décision.

examples.text: Was passiert, wenn die Vereinigten Arabischen Emirate als einer der größten Gläubiger der Türkei ihre Kreditvergabe überdenken?
examples.translation: Que se passera-t-il si les Émirats arabes unis, l'un des principaux créanciers de la Turquie, reconsidèrent leurs prêts ?

glosses: Repenser.

examples.text: Was sie mir sagen, verdient überdacht zu werden.
examples.translation: Ce que vous me dites mérite que j’y repense.

glosses: über etwas prüfend und intensiv nachdenken

examples.text: Er setzte sich hin und überdachte seine Entscheidung.
„Saudi-Arabien muss seine Strategie in der Region sowie seine Bündnispolitik überdenken und an die neuen komplexeren und wechselhaften Strukturen anpassen.“

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: über etwas prüfend und intensiv nachdenken

glosses: To consider a matter again.

examples.text: Is there any way I can get you to reconsider selling your car?

glosses: To change one's mind, with or without actually considering the matter again

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: über etwas prüfend und intensiv nachdenken

glosses: To think again about something, with the intention of changing or replacing it.

examples.text: Disability rights advocates are encouraging people to rethink the words "crazy" and "insane" as they stigmatize mental health.

There's a myth that incest survivors are an extremely small percentage of the gay male community. But that belief is something that needs to be rethought. One in six men (gay and straight) polled in a 1985 Los Angeles Times survey reported being sexually abused before the age of 18.
But the NCC has been forced to rethink its approach and has already extended the deadline three times, at short notice.

glosses: The act of thinking again about something.

examples.text: This business plan of yours looks risky. It needs a rethink.
Guardiola needed a rethink and his hand was forced when De Bruyne was forced off in the 58th minute after a check by Rüdiger.
There was a complete rethink in 2020, following a review into why costs rose by £100 million in the space of a year.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: über etwas prüfend und intensiv nachdenken

glosses: Considérer une nouvelle fois, réétudier.

examples.text: Et je me rends à tes raisons : je reste jusqu’à demain matin, à reconsidérer les agréments de la vie aux champs.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: über etwas prüfend und intensiv nachdenken

glosses: rivedere il passato o qualcosa in generale con più lucidità ed obiettività

examples.text: "Giovanna... Ripensavo a quella volta in cui siamo stati a Sharm el-Sheikh. I tuoi stanno bene, vero?

glosses: immaginare in un unico momento più eventi culminanti che hanno permesso a qualcuno di raggiungere qualcosa o di giungere ad un obiettivo

examples.text: Ormai vincitrice, si commosse dicendo: "Sì, ripensando a tutta la fatica ed al grande impegno per arrivare qua ed ora..."

glosses: esprime rimpianto in seguito ad una o più riflessioni

examples.text: "Ripenso ancora a tutto quello che ho fatto per lui... Non si merita niente!"

glosses: cambiare opinione
